name: How does a triplex compare to a duplex or fourplex for investment?

mainEntity.name: How does a triplex compare to a duplex or fourplex for investment?

acceptedAnswer.text: A triplex offers a middle ground between a duplex (two units) and a fourplex (four units) in terms of income potential and management complexity. A duplex provides fewer income streams but might be simpler to manage, while a fourplex offers more income but increased management demands. The decision factor often hinges on your investment goals, risk tolerance, and capacity for property management. Triplexes can be a good entry point into multi-family investing without the full complexity of larger buildings.
acceptedAnswer.description: A triplex balances income potential and management complexity between a duplex and a fourplex, suitable for various investment goals.
